implemented: V1 trip_item now stores created_at from PostgreSQL clock time; existing-basket tests compare every stored column before and after the API call.
Every service transaction sets a five-second PostgreSQL SET LOCAL lock_timeout; transient lock failures and other data-access failures use non-secret 503 envelopes after transaction rollback.
Request execution expiry is decided only after SELECT FOR UPDATE returns, using a separate clock_timestamp query; now < expires_at is the sole valid condition.
The unused mayMutate branch was removed.
expected_plan_version accepts the full nonnegative int64 range and rejects fractions, strings, negatives, and overflow instead of coercing them.
Integration JSON parsing uses the Spring Boot 4 tools.jackson ObjectMapper bean.

The database safety gate requires a non-superuser exact role and database, a role-owned schema named stog_m1_002_*, rejects public/task14/non-task schemas, and accepts only an empty schema or the exact seven-table Flyway/V1 footprint before fixtures.

A test-only forwarding DataSource proxy observes actual prepared-statement execution and physical commit. It supplies bounded signal barriers without mocking SQL, commit, or outcomes and is absent from bootJar.

PostgreSQL tests now force both cross-trip transactions to stage mutations before the global key collision, force member-removal ordering, force post-request-lock expiry sampling, and pause before physical commit to prove no pre-commit listener and independent post-commit visibility.

A PostgreSQL trigger-induced late request-result insert failure test proves item, version, and result rollback with no listener. Additional cases cover valid ended fixtures, upcoming save, ALREADY_EXISTS replay, exact expiry, Place delete restriction, max-version no-wrap, and bounded lock timeout.
Production still fails closed without an authentication provider; test authentication remains only under src/test; bootJar remains loopback-bound and contains no test classes.
The accidental build rewrite was reconciled rather than reverted: Boot 4 webmvc/Jackson 3 support remains, PostgreSQL is runtimeOnly, and the redundant defaultTasks declaration was removed.
